image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a white baby bib lying flat on a brown surface. The bib features a rounded neck hole with white piping/trim. In the center, there is an embroidered design of a white cartoon rabbit. At the bottom, there is a pocket containing a grey cartoon cat plush or patch. The material appears to be a soft fabric, likely cotton or a blend, with visible stitching details.

The grey cat figure in the pocket lacks clear anatomical definition or distinct separation from the pocket fabric. Its edges bleed slightly into the pocket lining, and its form is somewhat amorphous compared to the sharper rabbit above.
